blocks.title: TMX Universal Track Downloader
blocks.tagline: Browser add-on for bulk downloads, search statistics and 100% TMX badges on the TM-Exchange sites.

items.title: Bulk download
items.text: Downloads search results and trackpacks as a ZIP or as single files.

items.title: Statistics
items.text: Search statistics plus track and user insights.

items.title: 100% TMX badges
items.text: Shows the status in the 100% TMX project and warns about cheated maps.

items.title: Five sites
items.text: Works on TMNF-X, TMUF-X and the TMO, TMS and TMN exchange sites.

images.caption: The downloader panel next to a TMNF-X search

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: The add-on is available from the Chrome Web Store and from Firefox Add-ons, and as a release on GitHub. It is MIT licensed.
